rationale.conceptual: Standard computational chemistry method using off-the-shelf tools (GCMC in RASPA with UFF/TraPPE force fields) and a published crystal structure. No custom method or algorithm development is needed, only correct application of a well-established technique.
rationale.execution: The pipeline has a few sequential stages: download a CIF, prepare input files, run GCMC, extract zero-coverage Qₛₜ and 1 atm uptake. It uses a single simulation package and standard data processing; no fragile multi-tool orchestration or heavy environment setup.

difficulty.reasoning: The task reproduces a GCMC simulation of CO₂ adsorption using standard force fields (UFF/TraPPE) and a well-known open-source code (RASPA). No novel algorithm or deep domain reasoning is required; the main challenge is correctly setting up and running the simulation.

compute_estimate.reasoning: The rigid-framework GCMC simulation of a small unit cell with CO₂ at low pressure (up to 1 atm) runs on a single CPU core in a few hours and requires minimal memory and storage.
